Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:266

World-space position of a registry record — delegates to the shared sfGalacticVec Cartesian path so fly-to lands exactly on the rendered cloud point: records carry heliocentric galactic xyz, the cloud mounts on the Sun's pivot at the scene origin, and the same three-tier distance compression + disc tilt apply.

Parameters

s

SFState

Engine state (for the Milky Way disc tilt).

rec

SFRegistryRecord

The registry record.

Returns

| { x: number; y: number; z: number; } | null

{x,y,z} world position, or null without a scene.
